query_sql: SELECT CAST(value_in_use AS BIGINT) AS max_mem_mb FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = 'max server memory (MB)'
description_zh: SQL Server 最大服务器内存（MB）应 >= 1024，过低会限制数据库缓存并强制换页
description_en: SQL Server max server memory (MB) should be >= 1024, otherwise buffer pool will be capped

query_sql: SELECT CAST(value_in_use AS BIGINT) AS min_mem_mb FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = 'min server memory (MB)'
description_zh: min server memory 允许为 0（动态分配），但生产环境建议 >= 256 以保证基础缓存
description_en: min server memory can be 0, but production should be >= 256 for stable cache baseline

query_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS auto_close_count FROM sys.databases WHERE is_auto_close_on = 1
description_zh: 所有数据库 AUTO_CLOSE 必须为 OFF，开启会导致频繁关闭/打开引发性能问题
description_en: All databases must have AUTO_CLOSE = OFF; enabling it causes frequent shutdown/startup overhead

query_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS auto_shrink_count FROM sys.databases WHERE is_auto_shrink_on = 1
description_zh: 所有数据库 AUTO_SHRINK 必须为 OFF，开启会引发物理碎片与额外 I/O
description_en: All databases must have AUTO_SHRINK = OFF; enabling it causes physical fragmentation and extra I/O

query_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS bad_recovery_count FROM sys.databases WHERE recovery_model_desc NOT IN ('FULL', 'BULK_LOGGED') AND name NOT IN ('tempdb', 'master', 'model') AND state_desc = 'ONLINE'
description_zh: 用户数据库恢复模式应属于 FULL / BULK_LOGGED，SIMPLE 模式丢失事务日志恢复能力
description_en: User DBs should use FULL or BULK_LOGGED; SIMPLE loses point-in-time recovery capability

query_sql: SELECT CAST(value_in_use AS INT) AS backup_compress FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = 'backup compression default'
description_zh: 默认备份压缩应开启（=1），可降低备份文件大小与 I/O 压力（CPU 成本可控）
description_en: Default backup compression should be ON (=1) to reduce backup size and I/O

query_sql: SELECT CAST(value_in_use AS INT) AS opt_adhoc FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = 'optimize for ad hoc workloads'
description_zh: optimize for ad hoc workloads 应开启（=1），可避免单次执行计划占用过多 plan cache
description_en: optimize for ad hoc workloads should be ON (=1) to reduce single-use plan cache bloat

query_sql: SELECT CAST(value_in_use AS INT) AS max_dop FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = 'max degree of parallelism'
description_zh: max degree of parallelism 应在 1-8 之间（OLTP 1-4 / OLAP 4-8），避免 CXPACKET 等待风暴
description_en: max degree of parallelism should be in 1-8 (OLTP 1-4, OLAP 4-8) to avoid CXPACKET storm

query_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS blocked_count FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE blocking_session_id <> 0
description_zh: 阻塞会话数应 <= 3；超过则检查锁粒度与事务隔离级别
description_en: Blocked session count should be <= 3; otherwise check lock granularity and isolation level

query_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS slow_query_count FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) t WHERE r.total_elapsed_time > 60000 AND r.status = 'running'
description_zh: 运行超过 60 秒的慢查询应 <= 5 条；超过则存在性能瓶颈或缺失索引
description_en: Slow queries (>60s) should be <= 5; otherwise check for missing indexes or bottlenecks

query_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_frag_count FROM sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats(DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL, 'LIMITED') WHERE avg_fragmentation_in_percent > 30 AND page_count > 100
description_zh: 高碎片率（>30%）索引数应 <= 10；建议定期 REBUILD / REORGANIZE
description_en: Highly fragmented indexes (>30%) should be <= 10; schedule REBUILD/REORGANIZE

query_sql: SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN synchronization_health_desc IN ('NOT_HEALTHY', 'CRITICAL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unhealthy_ag_count FROM sys.dm_hadr_availability_group_states
description_zh: AlwaysOn 可用性组健康状态必须全部为 HEALTHY；任意副本 NOT_HEALTHY 即为高风险
description_en: AlwaysOn availability groups must all be HEALTHY; any NOT_HEALTHY replica is high risk
